newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-GLASGOW RANGERS V AUXERRE TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GLASGOW RANGERS V AUXERRE TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Wednesday's European Cup match between Glasgow Rangers and Auxerre of France in Group A of the Champions League:

Rangers: 1-Andy Goram; 2-Alex Cleland, 3-Joerg Albertz, 4-Richard Gough, 6-Joachim Bjorklund, 8-Paul Gascoigne, 10-Gordon Durie, 11-Brian Laudrup, 17-Peter Van Vossen, 20-Derek McInnes, 23-Craig Moore

Auxerre: 1-Lionel Charbonnier; 2-Alain Goma, 3-Franck Rabarivony, 6-Philippe Violeau, 7-Sabri Lamouchi, 8-Moussa Saib, 11-Bernard Diomede, 12-Taribo West, 13-Frederic Danjou, 14-Christian Henna, 18-Thomas Deniaud
